title: [GMCP 203.020.M] Mastery: GMCP server authoring SDK and plugin lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-020-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: A stable Susi-shaped authoring SDK builds local MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, MRTR handlers, tasks and extensions with schema derivation, typed context, middleware, testing fixtures and hot reload. Plugins declare permissions and compatibility, initialize transactionally, unload without leaks, preserve no vendor types across the boundary, and ship runnable minimal through production examples. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
limitations: Per `docs/gmcp-roadmap.md` (`VC-203-020`), `docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md`, and zero-UI plan A9, Core ships the protocol-generic server authoring SDK and fail-closed plugin host lifecycle with zero bundled vendor plugin packs (`DEFAULT_PACK_ID = "default"`; curated packs live in Susi Commercial Apps).

In-process `PluginBundle` attachment provides transactional capability/permission/checksum admission, panic-isolated execution, and leak-free unload with task cancellation, rather than an OS syscall sandbox (OS process/filesystem/network sandboxing is tracked under `VC-203-029`).

reuse.why: Wired `gmcp_vc_203_020_mastery` directly atop existing `production_reference_server`, `sample_plugin_bundle`, runnable examples `01..06`, `GmcpServer::serve_http_service`, `Session`, `TestHarness`, and shared `assert_bound_to_tested_commit` evidence helpers without duplicating production or test harness infrastructure.
